start: ^Narrator: SAFETYNET headquarters, Thursday, nine o'clock. HaX has your report up on the screen.

b: ^Agent HaX: It's the best file we've had on the Initiative. Motive, means, the Architect's signature and the Recruiter's calling card.
^Agent HaX: The file's strong now. It went through an innocent woman on the way, and that's in it too.
^Agent HaX: You built enough to move, and you closed it. There are gaps in the file, but it'll stand.
^Agent HaX: You stopped the upload. The file behind it is thin. The police will get what we send them, and it won't be much.
^Agent HaX: Patricia's copy of the CEO's email went to the Home Office review with the rest of the file. Nobody signs off on a stand-down like that twice.
^Agent HaX: QDC's readiness review passed. Nobody asked who cancelled Patricia's interview.
^Agent HaX: You said you'd be methodical. The file says you were.
^Agent HaX: You said you'd be methodical. The file's thinner than that promise.
^Agent HaX: You said fast and direct. Fast, and the file still holds. That's harder than it looks.
^Agent HaX: You said fast and direct. Fast, yes. The file paid for it.
^Agent HaX: You said you'd read the room. Then you put people in it on the floor.
^Agent HaX: You said you'd read the room. You did.

^Agent HaX: The final upload stopped at ninety-nine per cent. Most of the rotation windows were in the last of it, and they never went.

^Agent HaX: One region's did. When Security moved on Dr Halloran, he brought the upload forward, and its window went out before you got there.

^Agent HaX: The Home Office is re-keying the East of England a month early.

^Agent HaX: The final upload stopped at ninety-one per cent. The key material left in pieces over six weeks. The rotation windows were in the last of it, and they never went.

^Agent HaX: Without those, what they have is a very expensive paperweight.

^Agent HaX: The final upload stopped at ninety-seven per cent. The key material left in pieces over six weeks. The rotation windows were in the last of it, and they never went.

^Agent HaX: Without those, what they have is a very expensive paperweight.

bar_reaction: ^One region. Because I named the wrong person.
^How bad is the East of England?

c-0: ^Agent HaX: Yes. That goes in the file next to your name.
c-1: ^Agent HaX: A month of overtime for the Home Office. Nobody dies of it, because they moved first.

b: ^ Nine per cent to spare. You bought that yourself.
^Three per cent. I'd rather not do that again.
^Agent HaX: You had him before the server did. The research portal only confirmed a name you'd already given us.
^Agent HaX: Dr Halloran spent hours suspended because of a badge log read halfway. She was in Zurich. She's lodged a complaint, and she's right to.
^Agent HaX: You got to the front-door times in the end. It took a couple of goes.
^Agent HaX: You read past her line on the badge log. Her spare on the server hallway, his badge on the front door six minutes before, every night.
^Agent HaX: Halloran told you whose spare it was. The log had already said who carried it.
^Agent HaX: The badge log was in your kit. Its front-door lines had him all along.
^Agent HaX: Patricia Morgan spent the night in A&E. She's the one who got you into that building. She wants to know why, and so do I.
^Agent HaX: Owen Gallagher has a concussion. He'd have given you anything you asked for.
^Agent HaX: Lisa Park ran the collection for Elena. She's off work with a head injury.
^Agent HaX: Dr Halloran is off work. Her division's running without its head for a fortnight.
^Agent HaX: Dr Halloran is off work. Her division lost its two most senior people in one night.

the_night: ^Agent HaX: Every locked door in that building, you opened on someone else's trust. A colleague's badge, a colleague's password, his thumbprint.
^Agent HaX: In the logs, that looks exactly like an insider. It's why nobody saw him.

c-0: ^Agent HaX: Old software with a known flaw nobody had patched, and an admin login sitting in a handover note.
c-1: ^Agent HaX: Owen was, when he wasn't fixing everything else. The portal was worse: old software nobody had patched, and an admin login in a handover note.
g-0: ^Agent HaX: Once you were in, one account was allowed to run far more than its job needed. That's how you reached the Architect's sign-off.
^Whose job was it to fix that?
^QDC won't thank me for that part.

c-2: ^Agent HaX: Owen's, on paper. One sysadmin, after the budget cuts. The CEO wanted a clean file more than a safe one.
c-3: ^Agent HaX: The board won't. Owen might.

b: ^Agent HaX: For the training file: money. Debts he didn't declare, and treatment no insurer would touch.
^Agent HaX: Hours. His badge at the front door at two in the morning, and a borrowed one on the server hallway.
^Agent HaX: Hours. A cryptography badge in the server hallway near midnight, and nobody asked why.
^Agent HaX: For the training file: hours. His badge at the front door at two in the morning, and a borrowed one on the server hallway.
^Agent HaX: For the training file: hours. A cryptography badge in the server hallway near midnight, and nobody asked why.
^Agent HaX: An approach. A recruiter's leaflet, with a deadline scribbled on the back.
^Agent HaX: For the training file: an approach. A recruiter's leaflet, with a deadline scribbled on the back.
^Agent HaX: And a boss who told Security to stop asking.
^Agent HaX: For the training file: a boss who told Security to stop asking.
^Agent HaX: Halloran had the same recruiter at her table in Zurich. She reported it, late. Torres never reported anything.
^Agent HaX: You found him by what he did. Next time, look for the signs that come before.

torres_turned_path: ^Agent HaX: You turned him. The riskiest thing you could have done, and the most useful.
^Agent HaX: Elena starts the trial on Monday. We're paying, quietly, and if it ever gets dangerous we can move the family.
^Agent HaX: In exchange, he gives us the Insider Threat Initiative from the inside.
^What have we got from him so far?
torres_intelligence_gained: ^Agent HaX: Twenty-three active placements. He's giving us the companies, and some of the names.

b: ^Agent HaX: And the forty-seven on that TalentStack list. We're getting to them before the Recruiter does.
^Agent HaX: He's met some of the Recruiter's other candidates. Not the list. We'll come back to that.
^Agent HaX: He's met some of the Recruiter's other candidates. Not all forty-seven, but it's a start.

torres_intelligence_gained: ^Agent HaX: And how TalentStack actually works: the front, the payments, the approach.
torres_trust_question: ^Agent HaX: He's motivated. Elena's treatment depends on him.
^Agent HaX: And you got him early. Three months in, not three years. He still knows it was wrong. We can work with that.
^Agent HaX: If he wobbles, we'll know. That's the job now.

b: ^Agent HaX: He hit his head on the rack when he went down. You killed the upload and walked out. Nobody found him until the cleaners came through, forty minutes later.
^Agent HaX: He hit his head on the rack when he went down. You killed the upload and walked out. Nobody found him until Patricia went looking, forty minutes later.

torres_killed_path: ^Agent HaX: The pathologist thinks twenty minutes would have been enough.
^He came at me. I did what the mission needed.
^I didn't give him the chance. The upload was running.
^I should have stayed with him. I know.
torres_tactical_discussion: ^Agent HaX: The upload was the priority. Nobody will argue that.
^Agent HaX: But there was a gap between stopping it and walking away, and a man died in it. The review board will ask about that gap.
torres_weight_discussion: ^Agent HaX: He'd been ENTROPY's for three months. He was also a husband and a father. Both of those were true on the floor of that data centre.
torres_family_impact: ^Agent HaX: Elena Torres is a widow now, still fighting Stage 3 cancer. No treatment, no protection.
^Agent HaX: Sofia is eleven. Miguel is eight.
^Agent HaX: And everything he knew about the Initiative died with him. We're mapping it the hard way now.

b: ^Agent HaX: Detained after a fight. You stayed with him, kept his airway clear, and the ambulance came with the police. Textbook, once it came to that.
^Agent HaX: Detained at the terminal. You stayed with him, kept his airway clear, and the ambulance came with the police.
^Agent HaX: Detained after a fight. You stayed with him, kept his airway clear, and Patricia brought the police and an ambulance. Textbook, once it came to that.
^Agent HaX: Detained at the terminal. You stayed with him, kept his airway clear, and Patricia brought the police and an ambulance.

torres_subdued_path: ^Agent HaX: He woke up in hospital under police guard, angry, and he hasn't said a word to anyone since. What happens to him now is up to them.
^Agent HaX: Elena's treatment is unfunded. He never talked to us, so there's no deal to hang it on.
^He chose to fight. I gave him the chance to step away.
^I didn't give him the chance. The upload was running.
^Is there any way back to a cooperation deal?

c-0: ^Agent HaX: You did. And now we're both living with what came after.
c-1: ^Agent HaX: No. And he'll say so, if anyone ever asks him.
c-2: ^Agent HaX: Not through us. He's in police hands now, and we don't get to walk into their interview rooms.

b: ^Agent HaX: You held him until the police came. He hasn't said a word to them or to us.
^Agent HaX: You held him and Patricia called the police. He hasn't said a word to them or to us.

torres_arrested_no_treatment_path: ^Agent HaX: Our evidence reached them without our name on it. What a court gives him is out of our hands.
^Agent HaX: Elena's treatment is unfunded. She has months, maybe. Sofia and Miguel may watch that with their father on remand.
^I did my job. The rest isn't my department.

c-0: ^Agent HaX: They do. For everyone near him.
c-1: ^Agent HaX: That's what the review board will want to hear. I'm not sure I do.

b: ^Agent HaX: Without him, we're blind on the Initiative. The placements carry on. We have forty-seven names, and no idea which of them she's already turned.
^Agent HaX: Without him, we're blind on the Initiative. The placements carry on. The forty-seven stay in the pipeline until we find them ourselves.

torres_arrested_with_treatment_path: ^Agent HaX: He talked to you before the police arrived. Everything he knows about the Initiative, for Elena's treatment.
^Agent HaX: She starts on Monday, and we're paying. What happens to him is the court's business now. We couldn't promise him anything there, and you didn't.

c-0: ^Agent HaX: No. What he told us stays with us. The court sees him without it.
c-1: ^Agent HaX: Sofia and Miguel get their mother through this, and a father on remand. It's more than they had at eight o'clock last night.
g-0: ^Agent HaX: Less than a double agent would give us. A good deal more than nothing, and clean.

public_exposure_path: ^Agent HaX: You went public. The Initiative is front-page news, TalentStack's offices are empty, and the police picked Torres up the next morning.

b: ^Agent HaX: We rang the forty-seven on that list before the story broke. Most of them had never heard of ENTROPY. They have now.

public_exposure_path: ^Agent HaX: The twenty-three placements are blown. Their employers are running their own investigations.
^It was the only way to make sure they can't rebuild it.
^ENTROPY needed to see this cost them something.

c-1: ^Agent HaX: It did. Not only them.

public_exposure_consequence: ^Agent HaX: The Initiative is finished in this country, for now.
^Agent HaX: And David Torres is "The Quantum Traitor". Sofia and Miguel's classmates have seen their father's face on the news.
^Agent HaX: Elena is reading about it from a hospital bed.
^Agent HaX: And you did it as one of ours. When this goes right, nobody hears about us at all. This week, three newspapers are asking who their source was.

c-0: ^Agent HaX: It already has. Your consultant cover is burnt, and Netherton wants you in his office at two.

b: ^ You put the programme ahead of the man. I understand the logic.
^It's a win for the file. His family paid for it.

c-1: ^Agent HaX: Your consultant cover is burnt. Netherton wants you in his office at two.

b: ^Agent HaX: And the Recruiter. You never answered her offer. She'll have taken the silence for a no by now.
^Agent HaX: The TalentStack list went into your report. We've reached three of the forty-seven already.
^Agent HaX: We never found the list she was protecting. Her courier probably has it by now.
^Agent HaX: And the Recruiter. She rang you, she made you an offer, and you turned her down.
^Agent HaX: The TalentStack list went into your report. We've reached three of the forty-seven already. That's three she doesn't get.
^Agent HaX: We never found the list she was protecting. Her courier probably has it by now. Still, you didn't sell.

recruiter_reckoning: ^Agent HaX: One more thing. Your report doesn't mention the Recruiter's call.
^Agent HaX: The phone logs do. Four minutes, from a TalentStack number, right after you named him.
^She offered to keep me out of it for the list. I said yes.
^It was nothing. A sales pitch. I hung up.

c-0: ^Agent HaX: ...Thank you for telling me. That's the only reason this stays between us.

b: ^Agent HaX: The list goes in today. It's late, and some of those forty-seven will already have signed. That's on the record now, and on you.
^Agent HaX: Whatever that list was, it's with her courier now. That's on the record, and on you.

c-1: ^Agent HaX: Four minutes is a long sales pitch.
^Agent HaX: I'll leave it there. For now.

entropy_revelation: ^Agent HaX: The Architect's authorisation is the part I keep coming back to. A casualty projection, reviewed, and filed as an acceptable cost.
^Who signs off on a number like that?

c-1: ^Agent HaX: Someone who never has to hear the ambulance not come.

cells: ^Agent HaX: Ransomware Incorporated. Zero Day Syndicate. Critical Mass. Now the Insider Threat Initiative.
^Agent HaX: The cells share suppliers, targets and a signature. The Architect runs them like a business.
^Agent HaX: And pays them like one. The Initiative got eight hundred and forty-seven thousand dollars for this job alone.
^Agent HaX: The authorisation goes up on Task Force Null's wall, with every other directive we've pulled off a cell.

b: ^Agent HaX: Torres is an asset now. We'll be leaning on him for months.
^Agent HaX: We'll map the Initiative the slow way. Harder, but doable.
^Agent HaX: We'll be watching for their reply.

future_implications: ^Agent HaX: Every one of these operations has been paid for by someone. Next, we follow the money.

b: ^Agent HaX: Torres knows how TalentStack paid him. That's a thread we can pull.

final_reflection: ^I'd do it the same way again.

b: ^ You know the answer to that.

c-1: ^Agent HaX: I know. I read the report.

b: ^Agent HaX: You went looking for the man underneath. That mattered, whatever you decided in the end.
^Agent HaX: You never let him hide behind his story. Cold, maybe. But you saw it clearly.
^Agent HaX: I trust your judgement. Last night proved that.
^Agent HaX: You made hard calls, and you made them yourself.
^Agent HaX: The job got done. I'm still deciding about the rest.

mission_end: ^Agent HaX: Go home. Take the rest of the day.

b: ^Agent HaX: The people who'd have waited too long for that ambulance will never know your name. But they're alive.
